page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin (two notes: at the start of the paragraph beginning "Juvando" and beside the line "ftant apud Thucydidem"). Below the text, a section number "LXXXII.", a centred title, and the paragraph "Alios inquietudo..." follow in reading order.

main_text.p: lib.1. Ejufmodi benefactores aut amicos similes iisjus[?]-dico, qui ut extrahere quenquam aqua poffint, totum aqua demergunt; aut qui miferè per fpeciem amicitiæ alendos carceri impingunt. in his pofterius benefi-cium veniam fortaffis delicti[?], gratiam nullam meretur, Juvando op-primentes, Juvando opprimentium ordini & fœneratores, modum præfertim excedentes, accenferi poffunt. Poffunt huc etiam referri lenocinia agentes; poffunt qui sumptus in flagitia suppeditant, qui ad nequitiam, ad corrumpendam honestatem, aut vivendi facultates, consilio vel suasu suppetias ferunt; aut qui, cum coercendi potestatem habeant, per indulgentiam im-providam ætatem ruere finunt. Tiberiani moris fuit, quos ad supplicium rapturus erat, epulis adhibere, ho-noribus exornare, & aliis modis dementiam alere po-tius, quàm tempestivè opprimere. Ejusdem fuit, im-pari matrimonio animos & eminendi spem præcidere. Et quis omnia callidè nocentis, benignitatis monstra in classem compegerit?
main_text.head: Belli gerendi cupidis causæ belli non decerunt.
main_text.p: Alios inquietudo animi aut acquirendi fiducia, alios necessitas & lacessentium injuriæ ad bellum exstimu-lant. In posteriori ordine nostra memoria Belgæ; & in eodem regionum tractu olim Frisii, de quibus Tacitus ingenuè: pacem exuere, nostra magis avaritia, quàm obsequii impatientes. De causis belli, & suscipiendi promptitudine aut prolongatione, egregiæ ex-Thucydidis lecus[?]. stant apud Thucydidem libro primo Historiarum, dif-fertationes. Corinthi, dolore consiliario, omnibus votis ad bellum ruentes, Lacedæmonios tarditatis accusant. Athenienses, majorum bellica gloria elati, ad jus tamen & æquum provocant. Archidamus belli difficultatem, adversus homines audacia & opulentia valentes, remoram objicit. Cui contradicens ephorus, nomine Sthenela dasy[?], nec socios Atheniensibus pro-dendos, nec crescentem eorum potentiam negligen-dam.

page.notes: Two marginal notes: "Juvando op-primentes," (left, at the start of the paragraph beginning "Juvando") and "Thucydidis lecus." (left, beside "stant apud Thucydidem"); the second may read "lectus" and is uncertain. The word "dasy" in "Sthenela dasy" is doubtful. "iisjus-" at the top of the page is doubtful. "delicti" is uncertain (printed form appears as "deli&i"). The "lib.1." at the start of the page is treated as text. The running head is printed at the top left with the page number 358. The numeral "LXXXII." is a bare number and set as a paragraph; the heading "Belli gerendi cupidis causæ belli non decerunt." is set as level 2 because it is a title above a passage.
